In other words, the Komlós constant in dimension $n$ is $o(\log n)$.

nodes.summary: There are a real number $c > 0$ and a natural number $N \ge 3$ such that for every natural number $n \ge N$, the Komlós constant in dimension $n$ (the supremum of the discrepancy of real $n \times n$ matrices whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$, taken in $[0, \infty]$) is at most $c \log n$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Beck–Spencer–Gluskin logarithmic upper bound for the Komlós constant

nodes.summary: The statement that there are a real number $c > 0$ and a natural number $N \ge 3$ such that for every natural number $n \ge N$, the Komlós constant in dimension $n$ is at most $c \log n$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.
nodes.title: Beck–Spencer–Gluskin logarithmic upper bound (statement)

nodes.summary: A real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ is column admissible when every column of $A$ lies in the closed Euclidean unit ball, that is, $\sum_{i=1}^{m} A_{ij}^2 \le 1$ for every column index $j$.
nodes.title: Matrices with columns in the unit ball

nodes.summary: The following two conditions are equivalent. (a) There is a real constant $C > 0$ such that for all natural numbers $n$ and $d$ and all vectors $v_1, \dots, v_n \in \mathbb{R}^d$ of Euclidean norm at most $1$, writing $v_{ij}$ for the $j$-th coordinate of $v_i$, there are signs $\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$ with $\left|\sum_{i=1}^{n} \varepsilon_i v_{ij}\right| \le C$ for every coordinate…
nodes.title: The square and rectangular Komlós formulations are equivalent

nodes.summary: The statement that the uniform discrepancy bound for vectors in the unit ball holds if and only if the Komlós constant is finite.
nodes.title: Equivalence of the square and rectangular Komlós formulations (statement)

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the supremum of the discrepancy of $A$ over all real $n \times n$ matrices $A$ whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$, taken in $[0, \infty]$. The definition also applies to $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Komlós constant in a fixed dimension

nodes.summary: For every real $m \times n$ matrix $A$, including the cases $m = 0$ and $n = 0$, there is a sign vector $x \in \{-1, 1\}^n$ such that the discrepancy of $A$ equals $\|Ax\|_\infty$.
nodes.title: The discrepancy is attained

nodes.summary: For a real $m \times n$ matrix $A$, the discrepancy of $A$ is the infimum, over all sign vectors $x \in \{-1, 1\}^n$, of the maximum norm $\|Ax\|_\infty = \max_i |(Ax)_i|$ (which is $0$ when $m = 0$), taken in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Discrepancy of a real matrix

nodes.summary: The Komlós constant is the supremum, over all integers $n \ge 1$, of the Komlós constant in dimension $n$, namely the supremum of the discrepancy of $A$ over all real $n \times n$ matrices $A$ whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$. It is taken in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Komlós constant

nodes.summary: There are infinitely many natural numbers $n \ge 1$ such that the Komlós constant in dimension $n$ (the supremum of the discrepancy of real $n \times n$ matrices whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$, taken in $[0, \infty]$) is at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$.
nodes.title: Infinitely many dimensions have Komlós constant at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$

nodes.summary: The statement that there are infinitely many natural numbers $n \ge 1$ such that the Komlós constant in dimension $n$ is at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$.
nodes.title: Infinitely many dimensions with Komlós constant at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$ (statement)

nodes.summary: The Komlós constant (the supremum over all $n \ge 1$ of the discrepancy of real $n \times n$ matrices whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$, taken in $[0, \infty]$) is at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$.
nodes.title: Kunisky's lower bound for the Komlós constant

nodes.summary: The statement that the Komlós constant is at least $1 + \sqrt{2}$.
nodes.title: Kunisky's lower bound for the Komlós constant (statement)

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m$ and $n \ge 1$ and every real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ whose columns all have Euclidean norm at most $1$, there are unit vectors $u_1, \dots, u_n$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ such that $\lVert \sum_{j=1}^{n} A_{ij} u_j \rVert \le 1$ for every row index $i$, where $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ is the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Nikolov's theorem: the Komlós conjecture holds for vector colorings

nodes.summary: The statement that for all natural numbers $m$ and $n \ge 1$ and every real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ whose columns all lie in the closed Euclidean unit ball, there are unit vectors $u_1, \dots, u_n$ in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ such that $\lVert \sum_{j=1}^{n} A_{ij} u_j \rVert \le 1$ for every row index $i$, where $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ is the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Komlós conjecture for vector colorings (statement)

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m$ and $n$ with $n \ge 1$ and every real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ whose columns all lie in the closed Euclidean unit ball, that is, $\sum_{i} A_{ij}^2 \le 1$ for every column $j$, the vector discrepancy of $A$ is at most $1$.
nodes.title: Nikolov's bound on vector discrepancy

nodes.summary: This is the proposition that for all natural numbers $m$ and $n$ with $n \ge 1$ and every real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ whose columns all lie in the closed Euclidean unit ball, that is, $\sum_{i} A_{ij}^2 \le 1$ for every column $j$, the vector discrepancy of $A$ is at most $1$.
nodes.title: Statement of Nikolov's bound on vector discrepancy

nodes.summary: For $s \in \{0, 1\}$, the associated real sign is $-1$ if $s = 0$ and $1$ if $s = 1$.
nodes.title: Signs indexed by two elements

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a real constant $C > 0$ such that for all natural numbers $n$ and $d$ and all vectors $v_1, \dots, v_n \in \mathbb{R}^d$ of Euclidean norm at most $1$, writing $v_{ij}$ for the $j$-th coordinate of $v_i$, there are signs $\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$ with $\left|\sum_{i=1}^{n} \varepsilon_i v_{ij}\right| \le C$ for every coordinate index $j$.
nodes.title: Uniform discrepancy bound for vectors in the unit ball
Combinatorics

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
